usage: telegram-tools review list [-h] [--kind {media,link}]
                                  [--state {queued,approved,fetching,quarantined,accepted,rejected,failed}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {media,link}   Only links, or only files
  --state {queued,approved,fetching,quarantined,accepted,rejected,failed}
                        Only candidates in this state
